# C05-02 — Proposed channel organization

Status: verified

- Requirements: ST-012, ST-015
- Evaluations: EV-014
- Inputs: distribution plan and declared channel capabilities
- Output: proposed placement/series plus explicit unsupported capability results
- Dependencies: C05-01
- Acceptance: proposals never create remote objects or claim publication; platform concepts require declared capabilities
- Verification: exercise available, unavailable and mismatched channel concepts
- Limit: Studio does not publish automatically in the first delivery
